Third-party browser libraries bundled with this local HTML application:

1. SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3
   Copyright 2012-present SheetJS LLC and contributors
   License: Apache License 2.0
   Source: https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs

2. Tesseract.js 7.0.0
   Copyright Tesseract.js contributors
   License: Apache License 2.0
   Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js

Tesseract.js downloads OCR runtime and language model files from its pinned
jsDelivr sources when image recognition is first used. Payment images are
processed in the browser and are not sent to those model hosts.
